application.name: ${NAME}
application.supportedLanguages: ko en fr de es th

android.manifestAdditions: <manifest android:installLocation="auto"> <!-- Android 7: the minimum of Node (nodejs-mobile), which every build carries for playing on the phone (SH-13) --> <uses-sdk android:minSdkVersion="24" android:targetSdkVersion="${TARGET_SDK}"/> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE"/> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK"/> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.VIBRATE"/> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE"/> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE"/> <!-- SH-7: the asset download goes on in the background (DownloadService, dataSync) --> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC"/> <!-- Android 13+: the download's progress, the game's stamina reminders and the local server's notification --> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS"/> <!-- SH-7: scheduled reminders are armed again after a reboot (LocalNotificationReceiver) --> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED"/> <!-- SH-15: install an update the server offers; Android asks the player to allow it and to confirm each install --> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES"/> <application android:allowBackup="false" android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" android:resizeableActivity="true"> <meta-data android:name="android.max_aspect" android:value="2.4"/> <meta-data android:name="reflipped.server" android:value="${SERVER}"/> <meta-data android:name="reflipped.cdn" android:value="${CDN}"/> <!-- SH-15: the app's own version (also versionLabel above) and build ID, sent to the server and shown in the app --> <meta-data android:name="reflipped.version" android:value="${VERSION}"/> <meta-data android:name="reflipped.build" android:value="${BUILD}"/> <activity android:excludeFromRecents="false" android:resizeableActivity="false"> <intent-filter> <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/> <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/> </intent-filter> <!-- co-op room links (wdfp://social-room?k=<token>) and profile links (wdfp://profile?id=<viewer>), as in the original APK: AIR hands them to the game as an InvokeEvent with reason "openUrl" --> <intent-filter> <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW"/> <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT"/> <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE"/> <data android:scheme="wdfp"/> </intent-filter> </activity> <!-- SH-13: the Reflipped server on the phone, Node in its own process (reflipped.shell.service.ServerService). specialUse has no time limit in the background, unlike dataSync. --> <service android:name="reflipped.shell.service.ServerService" android:process=":server" android:exported="false" android:foregroundServiceType="specialUse"> <property android:name="android.app.PROPERTY_SPECIAL_USE_FGS_SUBTYPE" android:value="Runs the game's server on the device for offline single-player play"/> </service> <!-- SH-7: keeps the game's asset download going in the background, in the game's own process --> <service android:name="reflipped.shell.service.DownloadService" android:exported="false" android:foregroundServiceType="dataSync"/> <!-- SH-7: the game's local notifications (stamina full), and re-arming them after a reboot or an update --> <receiver android:name="reflipped.shell.other.LocalNotificationReceiver" android:exported="false"> <intent-filter> <action android:name="android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED"/> <action android:name="android.intent.action.MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED"/> </intent-filter> </receiver> </application> </manifest>
